prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Suzhou for a couple days, and we ended up chatting about what movies were showing around town.
Around the same time, my coworker was in Shenzhen and kept talking about how many restaurant options there were there.
In Suzhou, Chen Ming had already gotten tickets for that movie called YOLO, and it was for two seats.
He said the screening was at Broadway Cinema Gusu, and the showtime was 14:30—everything was set before I even heard about it.
Then later, Liu Yang told me they’d done a big group meal at Din Tai Fung Shenzhen, like a party of 10.
That lunch was on 2025-04-27 at 14:00, and the contact number he used was 13800112233—he was just recounting it afterward.
